capabilities: Display the cursor's character and line number in the status bar
Show selection ranges or cursor positions when multiple cursors are active
Report document position as a percentage or in word-based fractions
Customize display patterns, separators, and status bar padding in settings
Optionally count frontmatter, characters, and selected lines
extras: Desktop only; the README says mobile apps do not support custom status bar items. Includes a settings reset option and migration notes for settings that changed from text boxes to dropdowns.
problem: Obsidian's status bar does not show where the cursor is located (character and line number) within a document.
summary: Status bar item that displays the cursor's character and line position, with options for selections, percentages, and custom display patterns.
